correctness.rationale: The divisibility criterion reduces exactly to \(AB\mid 8bp^3q^{2b}\). Prime-support arguments are valid because \(b\) is a power of two; \(\gcd(A,p)=1\), \(\gcd(B,q)=1\), and for even \(b\), \(q+1\mid B\). These force \(p=3,q=5\), after which the exact lower bound \(B>25^b>216b\) contradicts divisibility. The accompanying checker independently validates the arithmetic formulas and bounded cases.
